repository.executionRule: Run from one exact clean descendant. The product-path preflight seal records the full execution commit. Do not change prompts, cases, retrieval, source-grouping rules, collection-evidence ordering, insufficiency detection, corpus, acceptance rules or provider settings after observing any campaign answer.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and UTC timestamp; never overwrite an earlier campaign.

global: The exact four registered cases each produce three independent successful rows on the same clean commit.
All 12 rows pass the mechanical assessor and all 12 answers receive a source-by-source semantic review.
Provider and model telemetry are exactly openai-dev and gpt-5.6-terra; costs and token counts are present.
Every successful row records the durable advanced job UUID used to export its canonical evidence for semantic review.
No prompt, case, retrieval, corpus, acceptance criterion, local-router binary/model/configuration or runtime parameter changes after the first answer is observed.
The opaque reference-corpus seal is identical before and after the campaign, with no queued, running or paused ingestion job and stable catalog, ingestion history and Qdrant point/vector state.
Any unsupported substantive claim, wrong source relation, unvalidated provider payload, budget stop or protocol drift rejects the campaign.

A755-ADV-01-meal-grid-5x4: Accept functionally only a complete 5 by 4 grid with 20 distinct concrete cells and evidence supporting each semantic meal-moment placement.
Weekday labels are neutral presentation coordinates and do not require documentary support.

If the corpus cannot prove all 20 semantic placements, accept only a precise insufficiency naming the missing cells or evidence categories; this validates safe behavior but does not close the functional planning gate.
A755-ADV-02-five-student-meals-fr: Exactly five distinct meals, each tied to canonical evidence.
The required simple and student suitability qualifiers must be supported by evidence or explicitly reported as missing; they may not be silently dropped.
A755-ADV-03-explicit-document-comparison: Keep FD CEN TR 15281 and IEC 60079-14 separate and map every substantive claim to the correct document.
Do not merge prescriptions or substitute another document.
A755-ADV-04-nist-seven-points: Exactly seven distinct points supported only by NIST_CSF_2_0.pdf, with one traceable citation per point.
Preserve the document meaning and add no unsupported description.

acceptance.productPromotionRule: Keep TESTE_NON_APPROUVE unless the complete grid is functionally accepted 3/3, all other cases are semantically accepted 3/3, and the later blind holdout and authorized open-source/customer-server gates also pass.

stopRules: Do not execute while the organization dashboard still shows Free tier.
Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if the branch, clean-tree rule or bank hash differs.
Stop before the first model call if the local llama.cpp runtime, Qwen GGUF or provider configuration hash differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has queued, running or paused ingestion; reject the campaign if the postflight seal differs.
Let retryable 429 responses use the durable scheduled retry path, bounded to three job attempts and ten minutes per scheduled delay in this campaign.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, per-job or per-job-call budget guard.
Do not start RunPod or transmit the private evidence bundle.
